content: Free Consultation Products search Products search Free Consultation Learning Platform VLE LMS Visit us on campus Inspire Customer Support Contact Reward Program FAQ’s Frequently Asked Questions FAQ How to start Quiz based assesment course? You can get help about how to start quiz based assessment course by watching this tutorial video: https://youtu.be/3f9FXa9fEk4?si=N6IrerDhjfXhl3iQ How can I get a replacement certificate? A learner can claim a replacement certificate from ILC (either in PDF format or Hardcopy) or an CPD Certificate/Diploma (only Hardcopy) from Training Qualifications by paying the replacement Certificate fee + postage charges. If you like to get a replacement certificate, please get in touch with our admissions team for further information. How long will I have access to Inspire London College’s Learning Platform/VLE? Learners will have access to VLE/Learning Platform up to 12 months from the date of enrolment. During this period, flexibility will be given to learners for completing the course at any time. After 12 months, access to VLE/Learning Platform will be terminated without prior notice, and for further information/communication, learners can contact via email. Who is Course/Training Provider? The course/Training provider is the one who delivers the course or training to the learners through online platforms or classroom-based programmes. In this case, Inspire London College is the course provider. How to access the LMS? You will receive a welcome email containing your login details and the LMS link. Click on the link, enter the credentials provided in the email, and log in. Once logged in, you will see a welcome message and can start exploring your dashboard and courses. How to start a qualification? After logging in, click on the “ Let’s get started ” button. Then: Choose your course type and click Next. Select your qualification level and click Next. Upload your required documents and click Next. Fill out your initial assessment form and click Next. Complete your VARK test and view your results. Wait for document verification by the admission team. Once verified, you will receive an email, and your student dashboard will be accessible. From your dashboard, you can view and start your course, follow units, submit assignments, and track your progress. How do I enrol for a distance learning course? Enrolling in a distance learning course at Inspire London College is quick and straightforward. Simply browse our course catalogue, choose your desired course, and complete your purchase online by clicking the “ Add to Basket ” button and proceeding to checkout. Once your payment is successfully processed, you will receive instant access to your course materials so you can begin learning right away. Alternatively, you can fill out the online application form. Once we receive it, our admissions team will contact you by email with the next steps and support you throughout the enrolment process. Can I enrol if I am a non-resident of the UK? Yes, Inspire London College’s distance learning courses are open to international students from anywhere in the world. We currently have learners from over 65+ countries, making ou r programmes/CPD- accredited courses accessible globally. If you would like to know whether a specific qualification framework (such as RQF or others) is available in your country, please contact our admissions team. Share your details, and we will be happy to guide you on the available options. Do I receive a certificate after completing a course? Yes, upon successfully completing your course, you can claim a Certificate of Completion by paying the applicable certificate fee. Certificates are available from: Inspire London College (PDF or hard copy), or An Ofqual-regulated awarding organisation (hard copy only, where applicable) You can check the certificate fee in the course description under the Certificate tab, on our Fees & Pricing page , or on third-party platforms such as Reed or Laimoon. Are all RQF qualifications recognised in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland? Our RQF qualifications are awarded through recognised Ofqual-regulated awarding bodies and are officially recognised in England. Before enrolling, it is important to check whether a qualification is suitable for your location, as recognition may differ in Wales or Northern Ireland. Our CPD-accredited courses, however, are available worldwide, providing professional development opportunities regardless of where you are. For more information, visit Find a regulated qualification If I cannot complete the course within 12 months, can I get an extension? Yes, extensions are available, but the terms depend on the type of course: CPD-accredited courses: If you have completed more than half of your course, you can apply for a 3-month extension for an additional £30. Regulated qualifications: Extension fees and terms vary depending on the qualification. Please note that Inspire London College reserves the right to approve or decline any extension request. What happens if I fail an assignment? It’s uncommon to fail an assignment because 100% online tutor support is available to guide you through your course. CPD-accredited courses: You can resubmit quizzes without extra charges , and there are no strict deadlines for completing them. Regulated qualifications: Resubmission is allowed according to your specific course plan , which is shared upon enrolment. Deadlines and assessment schedules depend on the awarding body’s requirements. What is a qualification? A qualification is an official recognition of learning that can only be awarded by an authorised awarding body regulated by a government organisation. In the UK, the most commonly seen regulator is Ofqual , which oversees academic and vocational qualifications in England . Other regions have their own regulators: Qualifications Wales – for qualifications in Wales CCEA Regulation – for qualifications in Northern Ireland Each regulator maintains a list of the qualifications it recognises. If you want a qualification recognised in multiple regions, each regulator makes its own decision. Learn more at: Qualifications Wales CCEA Regulation What are Awarding Bodies? Awarding bodies are organisations authorised to develop, assess, and award regulated qualifications in the UK. Most of Inspire London College’s qualifications are awarded through Ofqual-regulated awarding bodies, including Qualifi, OTHM, NOCN, iCQ Awards, and many more, ensuring that your certification is nationally recognised. For CPD courses, accreditation is provided by Step Ahead CPD Qualification, an independent body that recognises professional development courses, helping learners enhance their skills and knowledge. Unlike regulated qualifications, CPD accreditation does not fall under the national qualification frameworks. What happens if I fail my Final Test MCQs? If necessary, the learner will have to attempt the Final Test (online multiple-choice test – 2 attempts) and attempt the test a third time at no extra cost. It applies to quiz based CPD courses only and does not apply to Video-Based CPD training & Class Based Training. What is Ofqual? Ofqual (Office of Qualifications and Examinations Regulation) is a non-ministerial government department that regulates qualifications, exams and tests in England. What is the Regulated Qualification Framework? Qualification frameworks are designed to help you make informed decisions about the qualifications you’ve achieved and the qualifications you may need for the future. The Qualifications and Credit Framework (QCF) was in operation between 2008 and 2015. Since 2015, the Regulated Qualifications Framework (RQF) replaced the Qualifications and Credit Framework and is in use in England, Wales and Northern Ireland. Are all RQF qualifications recognised in England, Wales and Northern Ireland? We provide Recognised qualifications in England. Prior to enrolment or commencement of a course/qualification, it is advisable to check the suitability based on your geographical location. Rest assured, all our qualifications are fully acknowledged by Ofqual and hold acceptance in the UK and worldwide. However, it’s essential to verify recognition by any specific awarding body beforehand. For more detailed information, please visit the following link: https://www.gov.uk/find-a-regulated- qualification What is the difference Between CPD Accredited Course and Ofqual Qualifications? CPD Courses – CPD stands for Continuous Professional Development meant for developing or enhancing skills. Individuals or organisations develop CPD courses. For instance, Our CPD courses are designed by us (Inspire London College) and accredited by independent awarding & accreditation bodies such as Step Ahead CPD Qualifications. The CPD Accredited certificate of completion will be awarded by Inspire London College with a stamp/logo of CPD Organisation on it. CPD organisation checks and verifies course quality and assigns the CPD points for each training or course. Ofqual Qualifications : The Ofqual qualifications are listed on the Regulated Qualification Framework (RQF), the UK qualification’s national framework. Ofqual is a non-ministerial government department regulating qualifications, exams and tests in England. In this case, the awarding body develops courses and regulates by Ofqual. The Awarding Body awards the certificate of completion with the regulated framework stamp. Can I use CPD Accredited Course/certificate for membership with any organisation? We do not deal directly with any organisation to offer our learners membership. However, You can inquire from the relevant organisation who you seek to get a membership based on CPD Accredited Course. Usually, organisations accept the Regulated Qualifications/Certificates for offering membership. If I can not complete the course within 12 months, can I get an extension to complete my course? Yes, If you have completed your course more than half, you can apply for a course completion time extension with extra charges of £30 for three months. We do not directly deal membership or registration for our learners with any organisation. However, you can inquire directly with the relevant organisation if you are seeking membership based on Regulated Qualifications/Certificates. It is advisable to do this before commencing the course/qualification to prevent any potential disappointment later on. Please note that it is the learner’s responsibility to verify and commence the course/qualification with us. In the event that you register for a qualification through us and wish to seek a refund, it is only possible within the 14-day cooling-off period from the date of purchasing the qualification. When will the course start? When you purchase one of our courses, your enrolment is processed immediately. You will receive your login credentials and access to the learning platform instantly, so you can start learning right away. Our distance learning courses are open throughout the year, allowing you to study at your own pace. Do I need to attend the classes or lectures? For distance learning courses, all materials are provided online, so there are no scheduled classes or lectures; you can study entirely at your own pace. However, for class-based courses (such as our Phlebotomy courses), attendance is required for all practical sessions and lectures, as hands-on training is an essential part of the programme. Are these courses flexible? Yes, all courses offered by Inspire London College are designed to fit around your schedule. You can study from home or work, and there are no strict deadlines for completing assessments. What are CPD organisations? CPD (Continuing Professional Development) organisations are independent bodies that accredit professional development courses to ensure they meet recognised standards for skill and knowledge advancement. Courses accredited by CPD organisations help learners enhance their professional skills, but these organisations do not fall under national qualification frameworks such as RQF. Our program is designed to provide you with a holistic understanding of the responsibilities and tasks associated with working in the pathology department. title: FAQs | Clear Answers to Common Learning Questions
content: Products search Products search Products search Frequently Asked Questions How do I enrol for a distance learning course? To enrol in a distance learning course at UK Professional Development Academy, select a course from College’s course catalogue, and purchase straightway by hitting Add to the Cart button and paying at check Out. Once we get the information on your course purchase, our admission team will contact you within 48 hours for courses registration and enrolment via email (Excluding weekends). Fill out the online application form for enrolment. After receiving your application form, the admissions team will contact you and guide you in further steps. Can I enrol If I am a non-resident of the UK? UK Professional Development Academy’s distance learning courses are open to international students from any geographical location. Currently, we have students from more than 65+ countries; therefore, students from different regions of the world can enrol for online courses at UKPDA Do I receive a certificate after completing a course? Upon successfully passing the course, the learner can claim the Certificate of Completion by paying the certificate fee, from: CPD Accredited from UK Professional Development Academy with stamp of Step Ahead CPD Qualification (either in PDF format or Hardcopy) You can check the certificate fee on our website in the course description under Certificate TAB or at 3rd parties (reed.co.uk or Laimoon)’s websites under the course description section. How can I get a replacement certificate? A learner can claim a replacement certificate from UKPDA (either in PDF format or Hardcopy) by paying the replacement Certificate fee + postage charges. If you like to get a replacement certificate, please get in touch with our admissions team for further information. When will the course start? Unlike traditional education, distance learning courses are open throughout the year, and students can enrol anytime for any course. The login credentials and the link to our learning platform will be provided to you within 48 hours after enrolment. Do I need to attend the classes or lectures? Distance learning courses are provided online; therefore, there are no classes and lecture sessions for these professional development courses. As for class-based courses, learners need to attend the classes or lectures. Will I have a tutor? Courses at UK Professional Development Academy are delivered with 100% online tutor support. Therefore, if during the studies you need help, you can directly contact your Online Tutor via email at onlinetutor@ukpdacademy.co.uk Are these courses flexible? All the courses offered by UKPDA are completely flexible as they provide a self-paced learning process at home or workplaces, and there are no specific deadlines for completing the assessment. How long will I have access to UKPD Academy’s Learning Platform/VLE? Learners will have access to VLE/Learning Platform up to 12 months from the date of enrolment. During this period, flexibility will be given to learners for completing the course at any time. After 12 months, access to VLE/Learning Platform will be terminated without prior notice, and for further information/communication, learners can contact via email. If I can not complete the course within 12 months, can I get an extension to complete my course? Yes, If you have completed your course more than half, you can apply for a course completion time extension with extra charges of £30 for three months. Please be informed that UK Professional Development Academy reserves the right to grant extensions to the course duration. What happens if I fail an assignment? It’s a rare case that a student will not pass an assignment as 100% online tutor support is available. Students can re-take their assignments without extra charges for online courses /Qualifications only. What happens if I fail my Final Test MCQs? If necessary, the learner will have to attempt the Final Test (online multiple-choice test – 2 attempts) and attempt the test a third time at no extra cost. It applies to quiz based CPD courses only and does not apply to Video-Based CPD training & Class Based Training. Is the CPD course recognised? title: Inspire London College Overview & Accreditation
content: Inspire London College (ILC) is an established UK training provider based in West London. ILC offers accredited CPD courses and OFQUAL-regulated qualifications approved by recognized awarding bodies including Qualifi, OTHM, Focus Awards, and ATHE. Qualifications range from Level 1 foundation certificates up to Level 7 postgraduate diplomas. Campus training is held in London, and flexible online distance learning is available globally.

title: ILC Phlebotomy Practical Training & Certification
content: Inspire London College offers accredited Phlebotomy training in London. Part 1 covers theoretical foundations, infection control, and legal standards. Part 2 is a practical hands-on blood collection session using venipuncture training equipment and live simulated models. The total fee ranges from £150 for introductory modules up to £450 for the full combined certificate. Students receive an accredited certificate enabling them to work as Phlebotomists or Healthcare Support Workers in clinics and hospitals.

title: ILC Regulated Business Management Qualifications Fee Schedule
content: Inspire London College offers interest-free monthly installment plans for OFQUAL regulated business qualifications: 1. Qualifi Level 3 Diploma in Business Management: £200 deposit followed by 8 monthly payments of £46.25 (duration 6-12 months). 2. Qualifi Level 4 Diploma in Business Management: £250 deposit followed by 8 monthly payments of £53.75. 3. OTHM Level 5 Extended Diploma in Business Management: £350 deposit followed by 8 monthly payments of £130.25 (duration 12-24 months). 4. Level 7 Postgraduate Diploma in Business Development: discounted CPD courses start from £10 promotional rate. Payments can be made via debit card, credit card, PayPal, or direct bank transfer.

title: Difference between CPD and OFQUAL Regulated Qualifications
content: CPD (Continuing Professional Development) courses focus on practical skills, career development, and industry awareness with fast online completion. OFQUAL qualifications are officially regulated by the UK government's Office of Qualifications and Examinations Regulation, awarding transferable academic credits recognized by UK universities for bachelor's or master's top-up degrees.

title: UKPD Academy Overview & Accreditations
content: UK Professional Development Academy (UKPDA) is a premier British online distance learning institute. UKPDA specializes in CPD-accredited professional courses and regulated diplomas across Leadership, HR, Health & Social Care, Business Management, Fire Safety, and Project Management. All courses are 100% online with 24/7 access to the student portal and tutor support.

title: UKPDA Payment Methods, Installments & Promo Codes
content: UKPD Academy offers flexible and affordable payments. Students can pay in full or choose interest-free monthly installments. Payment methods include Stripe, PayPal, major credit/debit cards, and bank transfers. Special promo code UKPDA2026 provides additional discounts on selected CPD diplomas and endorsed bundles. No hidden charges; all course materials, assessment fees, and digital certificates are included in the price.

title: UKPDA Course Assessment, Exams & Certificate Delivery
content: At UKPD Academy, courses are assessed through online multiple-choice quizzes or written assignment submissions. There are no physical exam centers or fixed schedules; students submit coursework at their own pace. Upon completion, digital PDF certificates are issued immediately. Hard copy certificates are dispatched via postal mail worldwide with verification QR codes.

title: Refund and Cancellation Policy for ILC and UKPDA
content: Both Inspire London College and UKPD Academy provide a 14-day statutory money-back cancellation guarantee from the date of enrollment, provided the student has not completed more than 25% of the online course content or claimed an official completion certificate. To request a refund or course exchange, contact the admissions support team via email or support ticket.
